# Ezekiel 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Some of Israel's leaders came and sat down in front of me.

**2** Then the LORD spoke to me:

**3** "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts. They've placed the stumbling block of sin right in front of their faces. Should I let them come to Me for answers?

**4** So tell them this: The Lord GOD says: Any Israelite who sets up idols in his heart and puts sin right in front of his face, and then comes to a prophet for guidance — I, the LORD, will give him exactly the answer his many idols deserve.

**5** I will do this to recapture the hearts of My people, who have all abandoned Me for their idols."

**6** "So tell the people of Israel: The Lord GOD says: Repent! Turn away from your idols. Turn your backs on all your disgusting practices.

**7** If any Israelite — or any foreigner living in Israel — cuts himself off from Me and sets up idols in his heart and puts sin right in front of his face, and then goes to a prophet to ask Me for guidance — I, the LORD, will personally answer him.

**8** I will turn against that person. I will make an example of him and cut him off from My people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**9** And if a prophet is fooled into giving a message anyway, it is I, the LORD, who allowed that prophet to be fooled. I will raise My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.

**10** Both the prophet and the one who consults him will share the same punishment —

**11** so that the people of Israel will never again wander away from Me or defile themselves with sin. They will be My people, and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD."

**12** The LORD spoke to me again:

**13** "Son of man, suppose a nation sins against Me by being unfaithful, and I raise My hand against it, cut off its food supply, send famine, and destroy both people and animals.

**14** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, their righteousness would save only themselves — not the nation, declares the Lord GOD.

**15** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**16** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**17** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**18** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**19** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**20** Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, they could not save a single son or daughter. Only they themselves would be saved by their own righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.

**21** So the Lord GOD says: How much worse will it be when I unleash all four of My devastating judgments against Jerusalem at once — war, famine, wild animals, and plague — killing off both people and animals!

**22** Yet some survivors will be left — sons and daughters who will be brought out to you. When you see how they behave and what they've done, you'll understand why I brought this disaster on Jerusalem.

**23** Their behavior will show you that everything I did was justified — that I had good reason for it all, declares the Lord GOD."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **14:3**: These leaders sit down in front of Ezekiel to ask God for guidance — while their hearts are full of idols. God sees the hypocrisy immediately. You can't worship idols Monday through Saturday and consult God on Sunday.

- **14:14**: Noah saved the world. Job endured everything. Daniel stood against empires. But even those three, living in Jerusalem, could only save themselves. That's how bad things have gotten — no amount of someone else's righteousness can bail you out.

- **14:9**: This is one of the most unsettling verses in the Bible — God says He deliberately deceives false prophets as part of His judgment. If you insist on hearing lies, God will let the lies find you.

— PNEUMA
